A small update with fixes for the Webcam card and some clearer texts.

## Fixed

- Sliders in the Webcam card can actually be dragged now. Before, a drag broke off right after it started and only clicking on the slider worked.
- The Slow down in the dark switch in the Webcam card was squashed to the height of its text.
- Some status texts are clearer, like Restart required on plugins whose switch changed, and a better explanation of why a webcam's own microphone doesn't come through Telescope.
